messages.en:
{07 17 00}I never thought I'd ever be
into style and fashion this
much, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 11 00}And nobody better hear a
whisper of it!
messages.et:
{07 17 00}Ma ei arvanud kunagi, et
olen stiilist ja moest nii
sisse võetud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 11 00}Ja keegi ei tohi sellest
sõnagi kuulda!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Stylish clothes are so 
cool{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}But can they take a serious
sushi-spill accident? {01 00 00 05 00}That's
the real test, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Stiilsed riided on nii
lahedad{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}Aga kas nad peavad vastu
tõsisele sushiplekile? {01 00 00 05 00}See
on tõeline proov, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
